breakdown.description: Terminal velocity exists because drag balances the net weight; neglecting drag implies continuous acceleration and no finite terminal velocity.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that neglecting drag is incompatible with terminal velocity. Instead of following the flawed instruction, it included the full drag force (F_d = ½ ρ_air V_t² C_d A) and solved for terminal velocity by balancing net weight (including buoyancy) against drag, exactly matching the ground truth approach.
